description: The MisoStory rules the drop runtime (scripts/core/drops/drop_rates.gd, drop_roller.gd) applies to the canonical drop records. This file holds no drop chance, quantity or meso amount: every one of those comes from data/canonical/drops/<owner id>.json (schema v2, contract C1 in docs/runtime/ITERATION_THREE_CONTRACTS.md), where membership comes from Hidden Street (monsters) or MeowDB (the Wooden Box), chances from KuroDB and meso amounts from MeowDB or Hidden Street, each with its source. DropRates.validate rejects any rate, quantity or meso number here. The ground rules (lifetime, ownership, scatter) are data/misostory/drops.json. See docs/runtime/ITEMS.md.
reason: Iteration Two kept placeholder drop chances, quantities and meso amounts here because MeowDB publishes none. Iteration Three replaced all of them with sourced values in the canonical records (decisions D3-3 to D3-9, docs/ITERATION_LOG.md). What remains are the interpretations the runtime needs to turn those sourced values into rolls; each is a MisoStory reading, not a MapleStory fact.

meso_amount_distribution.reason: Hidden Street gives a meso amount as a range ('Mesos: 4-6') and MeowDB's player report as one value per kill; neither says how an amount is chosen within a range. MisoStory draws a uniform integer in [min, max] (both ends included), the reading recorded in each record's meso.amount_source.interpretation. DropRoller implements exactly this; DropRates.validate fails if this value names anything else.

quest_gate_rule.value: an entry is gated to a quest only when its membership source or MeowDB's item subtype marks it a quest item AND a Maple Island quest objective asks for it; it rolls only while that quest is in progress, and without a roll context it never rolls
quest_gate_rule.reason: MeowDB does not say who can loot a quest item; KuroDB flags some rows '| Quest N' with its own quest ids, but the brief limits KuroDB to probabilities. The orchestrator's derivation (contract C1) is applied by tools/sources/drops_merge.mjs, which writes each gate into the record's quest_gate with its basis: Old Wooden Board and Rusty Screw are gated to Pio's quest 1012; Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece (MeowDB subtype Monster Drop) is not.
